- `lg` — Square at --ayy-size-control-lg (40px compact, 48 comfortable, 52 touch), lg text.
- Density — Slot width, height and text size follow data-density across all steps.
- Width — Hugs its slots and separators.

**Custom element** `<ayy-pin-input>` (@danitesler/ayywi/elements) — An .ayy-pin-input containing .ayy-pin-input__slot <input> elements (optionally grouped in .ayy-pin-input__group with .ayy-pin-input__separator).
- attribute `type`: numeric | alphanumeric
- attribute `mask`: Render slots as password dots.
- attribute `name`: Form field name: syncs a hidden input with the combined code.
- event `ayy-change`: { value: string } — fired whenever the code changes.
- event `ayy-complete`: { value: string } — fired once every slot is filled.

**React** — `import { PinInput } from "@danitesler/ayywi/react";`
- `<PinInput>` renders <div role="group" class="ayy-pin-input"> of .ayy-pin-input__slot <input> elements. Props: `length` number — total slots when groups is omitted (default 6).; `groups` number[] — split slots into groups with a dash between them, e.g. [3, 3].; `type` "numeric" | "alphanumeric" — allowed characters (default "numeric").; `mask` boolean — hide entered characters as password dots.; `size` "sm" | "md" | "lg"; `value / defaultValue` string — current or initial code.; `onValueChange` (value: string) => void; `onComplete` (value: string) => void — called once all slots are filled.; `disabled` boolean; `invalid` boolean — sets aria-invalid="true" on the group and slots.; `name` string — renders a hidden input carrying the combined code.; `autoFocus` boolean — focuses the first slot on mount.; `placeholder` string — placeholder character per empty slot.; `slotLabel` (index: number, total: number) => string — accessible label per slot.; `...rest` All native <div> attributes on the group.

**Accessibility**
- Wrap in a Field with a Label (or aria-labelledby on the group), and keep each slot's aria-label ("Digit 1 of 6").
- The first slot carries autocomplete="one-time-code" so SMS and password-manager autofill populate the whole code.
- Digits always read left to right even in RTL layouts; ArrowLeft and ArrowRight move visually between slots.

**Do**
- Use a PIN input for fixed-length verification codes, authenticator tokens, backup codes and numeric PINs.
- Group 6- or 8-character codes as [3, 3] or [4, 4] so people can scan and compare them at a glance.
- Accept pasted codes containing spaces or dashes — connectPinInput strips them automatically.

**Examples**: Verification code & masked PIN. Copy-ready HTML and React in llms/pin-input.md.

## Search bar

Category: Forms. A rounded search field with a magnifier and a clear button, often used at the top of a phone list. It's a real search form, so phones show a search key on the keyboard. Also called: search-bar, searchbar, search, search-box, searchbox, search-field.

**Classes**
- `.ayy-search-bar` — Root: a <form role="search"> holding the field and an optional Cancel.
- `.ayy-search-bar--lg` — Taller field and text, for a search screen.
- `.ayy-search-bar__field` — The pill: a magnifier icon, the input and the clear button. The focus ring goes around it.
- `.ayy-search-bar__input` — <input type="search" enterkeyhint="search" aria-label placeholder>. Needs a placeholder: the clear button hides while it shows.
- `.ayy-search-bar__clear` — A button after the input with an × and aria-label="Clear search". Hidden while the field is empty; @danitesler/ayywi/elements empties the field on click and fires input.
- `.ayy-search-bar__shortcut` — Keyboard shortcut hint shown at the end of the field (e.g. ⌘K). Hides while typing.
- `.ayy-search-bar__cancel` — A text button after the field that ends the search ("Cancel").

**States**
- `hover` (`.ayy-search-bar__field:hover; .ayy-search-bar__clear:hover, .ayy-search-bar__cancel:hover (devices that hover)`)
- `focus` (`.ayy-search-bar__field:has(> .ayy-search-bar__input:focus-visible); :focus-visible on the buttons`)
- `disabled` (`.ayy-search-bar__field:has(> .ayy-search-bar__input:disabled), :disabled on buttons`)
- `typing` (`.ayy-search-bar__input:not(:placeholder-shown)`)

**Sizes**
- `md` (default) — The md control height (32px compact, 40 comfortable, 44 touch).
- `lg` — The lg control height (40px compact, 48 comfortable, 52 touch), larger text: the top of a phone list.
- Density — The field height follows data-density (the heights above).
- Width — The field fills its row; Cancel takes its own width after it.

**React** — `import { SearchBar } from "@danitesler/ayywi/react";`
- `<SearchBar>` renders <form role="search" class="ayy-search-bar"><div class="ayy-search-bar__field">… <input type="search" class="ayy-search-bar__input"> …</div></form>; other props go on the input. Props: `value / defaultValue` string; `onValueChange` (value: string) => void — every keystroke, and "" when cleared; `onSearch` (value: string) => void — Enter / the Search key; `onCancel` () => void — shows a Cancel button that runs it; `label` string — the input's name. Default "Search"; `clearLabel` string — default "Clear search"; `cancelText` string — default "Cancel"; `size` "md" | "lg"; `shortcut` string — keyboard shortcut hint (e.g. "Mod+K"); hidden while typing; `formProps` FormHTMLAttributes — props for the <form>

**Accessibility**
- role="search" makes the form a search landmark. Name the input (aria-label, or a <label>) by what it searches ("Search tasks").
- The clear button is a real button named "Clear search"; clearing puts focus back in the field.
- Esc in a type="search" input clears it in most browsers; Cancel is for leaving the search, not clearing it.
- Results that update as you type should say how many there are in a polite live region.

**Do**
- Use it at the top of a phone list or a search screen; filter as people type (onValueChange) or on Enter (onSearch).
- Say what it searches in the placeholder and the label ("Search notes").
- Put it in a Top bar's second row on a list's first screen.

**Examples**: Empty and with text, Large, with Cancel. Copy-ready HTML and React in llms/search-bar.md.

## Filter bar

Category: Forms. A bar that brings together everything needed to filter a list, table or feed: quick filter tabs, filter menus, search, and the filters currently applied with a way to clear them all. Also called: filter-bar, filterbar, filters, filter-toolbar, filter-group, filter-strip, faceted-filter.

**Classes**
- `.ayy-filter-bar` — Root container. A vertical stack grouping the main controls row and the active filter row.
- `.ayy-filter-bar--flush` — Flush variant without borders, background or padding, for cards or panels.
- `.ayy-filter-bar--sticky` — Sticky variant pinned to the top of scroll containers with a translucent glass backdrop.
- `.ayy-filter-bar--sm` — Compact size variant for tight headers and mobile lists.
- `.ayy-filter-bar__main` — Horizontal row holding search, filter tabs, triggers, and summary.
- `.ayy-filter-bar__group` — Cluster of filter triggers or controls.
- `.ayy-filter-bar__tabs` — Pill track container for quick filter status tabs (role="tablist").
- `.ayy-filter-bar__tab` — Individual filter tab button. Inverts when active (aria-selected="true").
- `.ayy-filter-bar__tab-count` — Count badge after a filter tab label.
- `.ayy-filter-bar__trigger` — Faceted filter trigger button opening a dropdown menu with checkbox items (aria-haspopup="menu").
- `.ayy-filter-bar__trigger-badge` — Badge showing count of selected values for that facet.
- `.ayy-filter-bar__active` — Row of applied filter chips (ChipRemovable) and the clear button.
- `.ayy-filter-bar__summary` — Muted results summary (e.g. "Showing 12 of 80").
- `.ayy-filter-bar__clear` — Clear all / reset button.

**States**
- `hover` (`.ayy-filter-bar__tab:hover, .ayy-filter-bar__trigger:hover, .ayy-filter-bar__clear:hover`)
- `focus` (`:focus-visible on tabs, triggers, and the clear button`)
- `disabled` (`:disabled on tabs or triggers`)
- `selected` (`.ayy-filter-bar__tab[aria-selected="true"], [aria-pressed="true"]`)
- `open` (`.ayy-filter-bar__trigger[aria-expanded="true"]`)

**Sizes**
- `sm` — Tabs and triggers at the sm control height (28px compact, 32px comfortable, 40px touch), 13px text.
- `md` (default) — Tabs and triggers at the md control height (32px compact, 40px comfortable, 44px touch), 14px text.
- Density — Tab and trigger heights and padding follow data-density.
- Width — Fills its container (inline-size: 100%); main row and active row wrap when narrow.

**React** — `import { FilterBar, FilterBarMain, FilterBarGroup, FilterBarTabs, FilterBarTab, FilterBarTrigger, FilterBarActive, FilterBarSummary, FilterBarClear } from "@danitesler/ayywi/react";`
- `<FilterBar>` renders <div class="ayy-filter-bar">. Props: `sticky` boolean — sticky header with glass backdrop; `flush` boolean — omit outer border and padding for cards; `size` "sm" | "md"
- `<FilterBarMain>` renders <div class="ayy-filter-bar__main">. Props: 
- `<FilterBarGroup>` renders <div role="group" class="ayy-filter-bar__group">. Props: 
- `<FilterBarTabs>` renders <div role="tablist" class="ayy-filter-bar__tabs">. Props: `label` string — aria-label for the tablist (default "Filters")
- `<FilterBarTab>` renders <button role="tab" class="ayy-filter-bar__tab">. Props: `selected` boolean — aria-selected; `count` ReactNode — number of items in this status
- `<FilterBarTrigger>` renders <button type="button" class="ayy-filter-bar__trigger">. Props: `count` ReactNode — number of active values selected for this facet; `open` boolean — aria-expanded for menu state; `active` boolean — aria-pressed when filters are applied
- `<FilterBarActive>` renders <div class="ayy-filter-bar__active">. Props: 
- `<FilterBarSummary>` renders <span class="ayy-filter-bar__summary">. Props: 
- `<FilterBarClear>` renders <button type="button" class="ayy-filter-bar__clear">. Props: 

**Accessibility**
- Quick filter tabs form a role="tablist" with an aria-label. Tabs announce aria-selected="true" when active.
- Faceted filter triggers carry aria-haspopup="menu" (set by DropdownMenuTrigger) and aria-expanded for open/closed state.
- Active filters provide removable chips with accessible remove labels ("Remove Status: Draft").
- Visible :focus-visible rings on all interactive tabs, triggers, and action buttons.
- High Contrast mode fills active tabs and outlines active triggers using system Highlight.

**Do**
- Use a filter bar above tables, cards, lists, and feeds that support filtering by multiple criteria.
- Use quick filter tabs for primary mutually exclusive statuses (All, Drafts, Published) with live counts.
- Use faceted filter triggers for secondary multi-select dimensions (Assignee, Priority, Label).
- Display applied filters as removable chips with a Clear all button so users see and modify current filters in one glance.

**Examples**: Status tabs, Faceted filters, Consolidated filter. Copy-ready HTML and React in llms/filter-bar.md.

## Sorting

Category: Forms. A dropdown for choosing how a list, table or feed is ordered. It matches the filter bar and sits next to it. Also called: sorting, sort, sort-menu, sort-button, sort-dropdown, sort-select.

**Classes**
- `.ayy-sorting` — Root inline-flex container for a sorting control.
- `.ayy-sorting--sm` — Compact size variant for tight toolbars and mobile viewports.
- `.ayy-sorting__trigger` — Unified dropdown button trigger opening a sort menu (aria-haspopup="menu").
- `.ayy-sorting__trigger--sm` — Compact size trigger button.

**States**
- `hover` (`.ayy-sorting__trigger:hover`)
- `focus` (`:focus-visible on trigger`)
- `disabled` (`:disabled on trigger`)
- `open` (`.ayy-sorting__trigger[aria-expanded="true"]`)

**Sizes**
- `sm` — Controls at the sm control height (28px compact, 32px comfortable, 40px touch), 13px text.
- `md` (default) — Controls at the md control height (32px compact, 40px comfortable, 44px touch), 14px text.
- Density — Control heights and padding follow data-density.
- Width — Inline-flex, hugs its content.

**React** — `import { Sorting, SortingTrigger } from "@danitesler/ayywi/react";`
- `<Sorting>` renders <div class="ayy-sorting">. Props: `size` "sm" | "md"
- `<SortingTrigger>` renders <button type="button" class="ayy-sorting__trigger">. Props: `size` "sm" | "md"; `open` boolean — aria-expanded for menu state

**Accessibility**
- SortingTrigger uses aria-haspopup="menu" and aria-expanded to announce menu state to assistive technology.
- Visible 2px focus ring on the trigger button (:focus-visible).
- Sort options inside the paired DropdownMenu use role="menuitemradio" and aria-checked for accessible single-choice state.

**Do**
- Use Sorting when users need to order a table, grid, search feed, or list by multiple properties.
- Pair SortingTrigger with DropdownMenu and DropdownMenuRadioGroup for accessible sort selection.
- Display the currently active sort order in the trigger label so users always know how items are sorted.

**Examples**: Unified dropdown sort menu. Copy-ready HTML and React in llms/sorting.md.

## Textarea

Category: Forms. A multi-line text field for longer text like comments and descriptions. It can grow as you type. Also called: textarea, text-area.

**Classes**
- `.ayy-textarea` — Root, on the <textarea>.
- `.ayy-textarea--autosize` — Grows with content (CSS field-sizing). Falls back to fixed height.
- `.ayy-textarea--mono` — Monospace font.

**States**
- `hover` (`:hover`)
- `focus` (`:focus-visible`)
- `disabled` (`:disabled`)
- `error` (`aria-invalid="true" (with a FieldError)`)

**Sizes**
- Density — Text follows control md; the minimum height (5rem) and padding don't change.
- Width — Fills its container. autosize grows with its content (Chromium; elsewhere it keeps 5rem and scrolls).

**React** — `import { Textarea } from "@danitesler/ayywi/react";`
- `<Textarea>` renders <textarea>. Props: `autosize` boolean; `mono` boolean; `...rest` All native <textarea> attributes.

**Accessibility**
- Label it (Field + Label), same as Input.

**Do**
- Use a textarea for descriptions, notes, prompts and config snippets (mono).
- Set rows for a sensible starting height.

**Examples**: Basic, autosize, mono. Copy-ready HTML and React in llms/textarea.md.

## Mentions

Category: Forms. A multi-line text field that opens a floating suggestions list right at the caret when someone types @ or #, for tagging teammates, channels or issues inside comments and notes. Also called: mentions, mention-input, mention-field, at-mentions.

**Classes**
- `.ayy-mentions` — Root wrapper around the textarea, caret anchor and suggestions listbox.
- `.ayy-mentions__textarea` — Placed alongside .ayy-textarea on the <textarea>.
- `.ayy-mentions__anchor` — Hidden zero-width anchor placed at the trigger character to position the popup.
- `.ayy-mentions__listbox` — Popover listbox (.ayy-combobox__listbox) of mention suggestions.
- `.ayy-mentions__option` — One suggestion row (.ayy-combobox__option) with role="option".
- `.ayy-mentions__body` — Name and handle row inside an option.
- `.ayy-mentions__label` — Person or record display name, truncated on overflow.
- `.ayy-mentions__handle` — Muted monospace @handle or #key at the inline end.

**States**
- `hover` (`:hover on the textarea or a suggestion option (hover devices)`)
- `focus` (`:focus-visible on the textarea`)
- `disabled` (`:disabled on the textarea, or aria-disabled="true" on an option`)
- `selected` (`aria-selected="true" on the active .ayy-mentions__option`)
- `error` (`aria-invalid="true" on the textarea (with a FieldError)`)
- `open` (`:popover-open on .ayy-mentions__listbox`)

**Sizes**
- Density — Textarea and option rows follow control md text and data-density.
- Width — Textarea fills its container; popup is 13rem to 20rem wide.

**Custom element** `<ayy-mentions>` (@danitesler/ayywi/elements) — An .ayy-mentions holding a <textarea class="ayy-textarea ayy-mentions__textarea"> and an .ayy-mentions__listbox of [role="option"] items.
- attribute `triggers`: Space-separated trigger characters (default "@", e.g. "@ #").
- event `ayy-mention`: { trigger: string, value: string, label: string, text: string } — fired when a suggestion is inserted.

**React** — `import { Mentions } from "@danitesler/ayywi/react";`
- `<Mentions>` renders <div class="ayy-mentions"> wrapping <textarea>, caret anchor and <ul role="listbox">. Props: `options` MentionOption[] — id, label, value?, trigger?, icon?, keywords?, disabled?; `triggers` string[] — trigger characters (default ["@"]).; `onValueChange` (value: string) => void; `onMention` (option: MentionOption, detail: MentionInsertDetail) => void; `autosize` boolean — grow vertically with content.; `mono` boolean — monospace font.; `className` string — on the outer .ayy-mentions wrapper.; `...rest` All native <textarea> attributes (value, defaultValue, rows, placeholder…).

**Accessibility**
- Label the textarea with Field + Label (htmlFor/id), just like Textarea.
- Focus stays inside the textarea: ArrowUp and ArrowDown update aria-activedescendant, Enter or Tab inserts, and Escape closes the popup without closing a parent Dialog.
- Triggers only fire at the start of a line or after whitespace/punctuation, so typing email addresses never opens the popup.

**Do**
- Use Mentions for comments, review notes, chat composers and issue descriptions where people reference teammates (@) or records (#).
- Pass keywords on options (such as role or full handle) so people find teammates either by name or username.

**Examples**: Teammate @mentions & #issues. Copy-ready HTML and React in llms/mentions.md.

## Block editor

Category: Forms. A Notion-style document editor made of blocks: text, three headings, bulleted, numbered and to-do lists, quotes, callouts, code, dividers, images, embeds and files. Enter starts a new block and Backspace joins it to the one above, the arrows move between blocks as if they were one text, Markdown shortcuts and / turn a line into another block, a quiet bar formats a selection, @ inserts mention chips, and the handle in the gutter drags blocks (one or a selection of them) to a new place. Also called: block-editor, rich-text-editor, rich-text, wysiwyg, notion-editor, document-editor, notes-editor, page-editor.

**Classes**
- `.ayy-block-editor` — Root. The editor renders its blocks inside it, then the floating menu, formatting bar and caret anchor. Leave room at its inline start for the gutter (about 3.25rem of padding in its container), or use --inset.
- `.ayy-block-editor--inset` — Keeps the gutter inside the editor's own box, for containers with no padding to hang it in.
- `.ayy-block-editor__block` — One block. data-type says what it is; data-indent (1–4) nests it, data-checked marks a done to-do, data-selected a block in a block selection, data-dragging one being carried. In plain HTML you can write just <div class="ayy-block-editor__block" data-type="heading-1">Title</div>; the editor builds the rest.
- `.ayy-block-editor__gutter` — The + and the drag handle at the block's inline start; shown while the pointer is over the block (on touch screens, next to the line being written).
- `.ayy-block-editor__add` — The + button: a new line below with / typed, so the block menu opens. Alt-click adds it above.
- `.ayy-block-editor__handle` — The drag handle (.ayy-drag-handle): drag to move the block, or every selected block; click for block actions (duplicate, move, delete, turn into).
- `.ayy-block-editor__text` — The editable line of a text block (contenteditable, role="textbox"). Inline content: strong, em, u, s, code, links and mention chips. Shows data-placeholder while empty.
- `.ayy-block-editor__marker` — A list's bullet or number, drawn by the editor (1. a. i. by nesting level).
- `.ayy-block-editor__check` — A to-do's checkbox (.ayy-checkbox).
- `.ayy-block-editor__icon` — A callout's icon.
- `.ayy-block-editor__code-bar` — A code block's header, over the top of the code: the language at the start, Copy at the end (shown on hover).
- `.ayy-block-editor__code-button` — A button in the code header: the language (opens a menu of languages; plain text in read-only) or Copy (a check while copied, data-copied).
- `.ayy-block-editor__rule` — A divider's line (<hr>).
- `.ayy-block-editor__media` — The <figure> of an image or embed block.
- `.ayy-block-editor__frame` — The box around an image, a player or a link card. data-ratio="video|audio|square" sizes a provider's player.
- `.ayy-block-editor__image` — An image block's <img>.
- `.ayy-block-editor__resize` — The handle on an image's inline-end edge (role="separator"): drag, or use the arrow keys, to set its width.
- `.ayy-block-editor__caption` — An image or embed's editable caption (also the image's alt text). Its placeholder shows on hover and focus.
- `.ayy-block-editor__bookmark` — An embed of a page that isn't a player: a quiet card with the site and the address.
- `.ayy-block-editor__bookmark-title` — The site's name in a link card.
- `.ayy-block-editor__bookmark-url` — The address in a link card, truncated.
- `.ayy-block-editor__file` — A file block: a link to download it, with its icon, name and size.
- `.ayy-block-editor__file-name` — A file's name, truncated.
- `.ayy-block-editor__file-size` — A file's size, muted.
- `.ayy-block-editor__empty` — An image, embed or file block with nothing in it yet: a muted panel with a link field and an Upload button. aria-busy="true" while a file uploads.
- `.ayy-block-editor__mention` — A mention chip inside text (contenteditable="false", data-trigger, data-id, data-label): text with a faint wash, never a loud pill.
- `.ayy-block-editor__mention-trigger` — The @ or # of a mention, muted.
- `.ayy-block-editor__menu` — The floating list (.ayy-combobox__listbox) for /, mentions, block actions and a code block's language. data-mode="slash|mention|actions|language".
- `.ayy-block-editor__menu-label` — A group heading in the menu (Basic blocks, Media, People, Turn into).
- `.ayy-block-editor__option` — One menu row (.ayy-combobox__option, role="option"). data-current marks a block's current type, data-destructive Delete.
- `.ayy-block-editor__option-icon` — The tile in front of a menu row: the block type's icon, or an Avatar for a person.
- `.ayy-block-editor__option-text` — A menu row's name and hint.
- `.ayy-block-editor__option-hint` — A menu row's muted second line.
- `.ayy-block-editor__toolbar` — The formatting bar (.ayy-toolbar--floating) over a text selection: bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, code, link. Over a link it shows the link's address.
- `.ayy-block-editor__link-form` — The link field in the formatting bar, with Open and Remove.
- `.ayy-block-editor__anchor` — A hidden box the script places over the caret or the selection for the menu and the bar to hang from.

**States**
- `hover` (`:hover on a block (devices that hover)`)
- `focus` (`A line with the caret (:focus inside .ayy-block-editor__text), or the editor itself while blocks are selected; :focus-visible on the gutter buttons, the resize handle, link cards and file rows`)
- `selected` (`data-selected on blocks: Esc in a line, Shift+click, Mod+A twice, or the handle's menu`)
- `loading` (`aria-busy="true" on .ayy-block-editor__empty while a dropped, pasted or picked file uploads`)
- `checked` (`data-checked on a to-do block (its checkbox, or Mod+Enter in the line)`)
- `dragging` (`data-dragging on the blocks being carried by the handle`)
- `empty` (`data-empty on the root: the document is one empty line`)
- `typing` (`data-typing on the root: set by typing, cleared when the pointer moves or presses`)
- `read-only` (`readOnly / the readonly attribute (aria-readonly="true" on the root)`)

**Sizes**
- Density — Text follows the type scale (body --ayy-text-md, headings 3xl, 2xl and xl), not density. Menu rows, the formatting bar and the media panel's field and button follow the control sizes, so data-density="touch" makes them bigger; the gutter buttons stay 1.5rem.
- Width — Fills its container; images and embeds fill the column (an image can be resized from 20% to 100%). The gutter hangs about 3.25rem outside the inline start, or inside with --inset.

**Custom element** `<ayy-block-editor>` (@danitesler/ayywi/elements) — A <div class="ayy-block-editor"> of blocks, and optionally a <script type="application/json" data-mentions> with mention lists.
- attribute `placeholder`: Shown while the document is empty.
- attribute `label`: Accessible name of the editor (default "Editor").
- attribute `readonly`: Show the document without editing it.
- event `ayy-change`: { value } — every block, after each change.
- event `ayy-mention-click`: { trigger, id, label } — a mention chip was clicked.

**React** — `import { BlockEditor } from "@danitesler/ayywi/react";`
- `<BlockEditor>` renders <div class="ayy-block-editor"> that the editor fills with blocks. Props: `value` BlockEditorBlock[] — the document, controlled (pass back what onChange gives you).; `defaultValue` BlockEditorBlock[] — the document to start with, uncontrolled.; `onChange` (value: BlockEditorBlock[]) => void — after every change.; `placeholder` string — shown while the document is empty.; `readOnly` boolean — show the document without editing it.; `mentions` BlockEditorMentionSource[] — { trigger, label?, options } per trigger; options is a list of { id, label, hint?, avatar? } or a (query) => list or Promise of one.; `upload` (file: File) => string | Promise<string> — store a pasted, dropped or picked file, return its URL. Default: a data: URL.; `onMentionClick` (mention: { trigger, id, label }, event: MouseEvent) => void; `inset` boolean — keep the gutter inside the editor's box.; `aria-label` string — accessible name of the editor (default "Editor").; `...rest` Native <div> attributes (id, className, style…).

**Accessibility**
- Name the editor (aria-label in React, label on <ayy-block-editor>): it's a role="group" of lines, each a role="textbox" named by its type (Text, Heading 1, To-do list).
- Everything works from the keyboard: Enter, Backspace and the arrows move through blocks; Tab and Shift+Tab nest; Esc selects the block (then ↑/↓, Shift+↑/↓, Delete, Mod+D, Mod+Shift+↑/↓, Enter to edit again); Mod+/ opens block actions, Mod+Alt+0–8 turns a block into another type, Mod+B/I/U, Mod+Shift+S, Mod+E and Mod+K format. Tab nests, so the way out of the editor is Esc twice, then Tab.
- The / and mention menus keep focus in the line: ↑/↓ move through aria-activedescendant, Enter or Tab picks, Esc closes without closing a parent Dialog. The block actions menu takes focus and gives it back.
- Block selections, moves and failed uploads are read out in a polite live region.
- Images take their caption as alt text: write one for every picture that carries meaning.

**Do**
- Use a Block editor for documents people write and come back to: notes on a task, a page in a wiki, a spec, a long description with headings, lists, to-dos and media.
- Store the value (blocks) as it is, or convert it with blockEditorToMarkdown / blockEditorFromMarkdown when the storage is Markdown, and render it elsewhere with blockEditorToHtml.
- Pass mentions for the people and records your app has (@ for people, # for issues), with a function when the list is long or remote.
- Pass upload so pasted, dropped and picked files go to your storage instead of the default data: URLs.

**Examples**: A page: headings, lists, to-dos, a callout, mentions, an image and code, Task notes in a Card, editable or read-only. Copy-ready HTML and React in llms/block-editor.md.

## Inline edit

Category: Forms. A value that becomes an input where it sits: a page or card title, a project name, a version, a due date. Click it or press Enter to edit, Enter saves, Esc cancels, blur saves, and a multiline field grows as you type and saves on Mod+Enter. Also called: inline-edit, inline-editor, editable, click-to-edit, edit-in-place.

**Classes**
- `.ayy-inline-edit` — Root: one grid cell shared by the display button and the field, both at least the control's height, so swapping them doesn't move the content for a one-line value. Put the raw value in data-value.
- `.ayy-inline-edit__display` — The value at rest, as a <button type="button"> named by aria-label ("Rename the project"). It is hidden while the field is open.
- `.ayy-inline-edit__text` — The value inside the display button. It may be formatted (24 Oct 2026 while data-value is 2026-10-24); when empty, data-placeholder shows as muted text.
- `.ayy-inline-edit__input` — The field: .ayy-input for one line or .ayy-textarea with rows="1" for more. Hidden until editing starts.
- `.ayy-inline-edit--title` — Title variant: the display and the field take --ayy-font-heading at --ayy-text-xl, semibold.

**States**
- `hover` (`.ayy-inline-edit__display:hover (devices that hover)`)
- `focus` (`.ayy-inline-edit__display:focus-visible, and .ayy-inline-edit__input:focus-visible while editing`)
- `disabled` (`disabled on the display button and the field`)
- `error` (`aria-invalid="true" on the field (passed through inputProps or textareaProps)`)
- `editing` (`editing / defaultEditing, or a click or Enter on the display button`)

**Sizes**
- Density — The display button and the field both keep --ayy-size-control-md (32px compact, 40px comfortable, 44px touch), so a one-line value doesn't move the row when an edit starts or ends; the field's text is --ayy-control-text-field. The title variant's --ayy-text-xl type stays the same at every density.
- Width — Fills its container. The display text wraps long words, keeps the author's line breaks and never scrolls sideways; a multiline field grows to its content.

**Custom element** `<ayy-inline-edit>` (@danitesler/ayywi/elements) — 
- event `ayy-change`: { value } — after a commit, only when the value changed. Update any formatted display text from it.
- event `ayy-edit`: { editing } — true when the field opens, false however it closes.

**React** — `import { InlineEdit } from "@danitesler/ayywi/react";`
- `<InlineEdit>` renders <div class="ayy-inline-edit" data-value> <button class="ayy-inline-edit__display"><span class="ayy-inline-edit__text"> + <input class="ayy-input ayy-inline-edit__input"> (or <textarea class="ayy-textarea ..." rows="1">). Props: `value / defaultValue` string — the raw value; value makes it controlled; `onValueChange` (value: string) => void — after a commit, only when the value changed; `label` string — the display button's and the field's aria-label, written as the action ("Rename the project"); `displayValue` ReactNode — what the display shows at rest; defaults to the value (a formatted date, a price); `placeholder` string — shown when the value is empty, in the display and in the field; `multiline` boolean — use a growing <textarea>; saves on ⌘Enter / Ctrl+Enter; `variant` "text" | "title"; `disabled` boolean — disables the display button and the field; `editing / defaultEditing` boolean — edit mode, controlled, or the starting one; `onEditingChange` (editing: boolean) => void — when edit mode starts or ends; `onCancel` () => void — Esc threw the draft away; `trim` boolean — trim the value on commit. Default true; `inputProps` props for the single-line <input> (id, aria-describedby, aria-invalid, autoComplete…); `textareaProps` props for the multiline <textarea> (rows, maxLength…); `className` string — on the root, never on the field

**Accessibility**
- The display is a real button and the field is a real input: give both the same aria-label (label in React), written as the action ("Rename the project"), and keep it when the value changes.
- Enter saves, Esc cancels and puts focus back on the display button; blur and Tab save without pulling focus back.
- Enter while an IME is composing is left to the IME, so a Japanese, Chinese or Korean word can be confirmed without saving.
- The empty value shows the placeholder as text, not as the only name: the button keeps its aria-label.

**Do**
- Use inline edit for a short value people rename in place: a page title, a project or file name, a version, a due date.
- Write the label as the action ("Rename the project"), and keep a formatted displayValue in React when the raw value isn't what people should read.
- Keep the raw value in data-value (plain HTML) and format only the .ayy-inline-edit__text.

**Examples**: Title, Description. Copy-ready HTML and React in llms/inline-edit.md.

## Select

Category: Forms. A dropdown for choosing one option from a list. It's the native select with a nicer list on desktop, and the system picker on touch devices. Also called: select, native-select, picker, listbox, custom-select.

**Classes**
- `.ayy-select` — Wrapper element. Draws the chevron and sets the height.
- `.ayy-select__control` — On the <select> inside the wrapper.
- `.ayy-select__list` — The options list (role="listbox" popover) that React Select and "@danitesler/ayywi/elements" build from the <option>s while it's open. Don't write it yourself.
- `.ayy-select__option` — One option in the list (role="option"); aria-selected="true" on the chosen one, aria-disabled for a disabled <option>.
- `.ayy-select__label` — An <optgroup>'s label in the list.
- `.ayy-select__picture` — A picture for one option (a theme thumbnail, "Aa" in a font, a colour): a <span aria-hidden="true" data-value="<the option's value>"> after the <select> in the wrapper, one per option, all but the chosen one hidden. The chosen one shows at the control's inline start (32×20px); the list shows each before its option's text (88px wide, 16:10). It's a frame (border, tint, rounded) and a size container, so what's inside can size itself in container units.
- `.ayy-select--sm` — Small.
- `.ayy-select--lg` — Large.

**States**
- `hover` (`.ayy-select__control:hover; .ayy-select__option:hover`)
- `focus` (`.ayy-select__control:focus-visible; .ayy-select__option:focus-visible`)
- `disabled` (`.ayy-select__control:disabled; a disabled <option> (aria-disabled on its list option)`)
- `selected` (`.ayy-select__option[aria-selected="true"] (the <option> that's selected)`)
- `error` (`.ayy-select__control[aria-invalid="true"]`)
- `open` (`.ayy-select__control[aria-expanded="true"] while the list shows`)
- `multiple` (`multiple, or size > 1`)

**Sizes**
- `sm` — Control sm height (28px compact, 32 comfortable, 40 touch), sm text.
- `md` (default) — Control md height (32px compact, 40 comfortable, 44 touch).
- `lg` — Control lg height (40px compact, 48 comfortable, 52 touch), lg text.
- Density — Height and text follow data-density.
- Width — Fills its container; long option text is cut with an ellipsis. The list is at least the select's width and at most 24rem; its options are the md control height, or as tall as their picture (up to 32rem of list) with pictures.

**React** — `import { Select } from "@danitesler/ayywi/react";`
- `<Select>` renders <div class="ayy-select"><select class="ayy-select__control">. Props: `size` "sm" | "md" | "lg"; `pictures` Record<string, ReactNode> — a picture per option value: rendered as .ayy-select__picture spans after the <select>; the chosen one shows before the text and the list shows each; `onChoose` (value: string) => void — every choice from ayywi's list, the option already chosen included (onChange only fires for a new one), for an option that acts each time, such as Custom colour; `wrapperProps` Props for the wrapper <div>; `...rest` All native <select> attributes and events (onChange fires when an option is chosen from the list too); className goes to the <select>.

**Accessibility**
- Label it like any input (Field + Label with for/id); the list takes the same name.
- The list is a role="listbox" of role="option"s: arrows, Home/End and type-ahead move, Enter, Space or a click chooses, Esc, Tab or a click outside closes, and focus goes back to the select.
- Touch screens keep the OS picker, which suits them better. Don't build your own dropdown for choosing a value: this is it.
- Pictures are aria-hidden: an option's text names it, in the list and in the OS picker.

**Do**
- Use a select to choose one option from a longer list (country, time zone, role).
- Put a sensible default first, or a disabled placeholder option.
- Write a plain <select> with <option>s (or React Select): the list comes with it. In plain HTML load elements.global.js (or import "@danitesler/ayywi/elements").
- Give options pictures when the choice is visual (a theme, a font, a colour): one .ayy-select__picture per option (React: pictures). Phones keep the OS picker with text only, so the option text must still say what it is.

**Examples**: Sizes, states and pictures. Copy-ready HTML and React in llms/select.md.

## Combobox

Category: Forms. A text field that filters a list as you type, for picking one option from a long set like a city, a customer or a time zone. The options open under the field and follow the standard accessible pattern. Also called: combobox, autocomplete, typeahead, suggest, suggestions.

**Classes**
- `.ayy-combobox` — Wrapper: the .ayy-input (role="combobox"), a chevron <svg> and the listbox.
- `.ayy-combobox__listbox` — The <ul role="listbox" popover="manual"> of options, placed under the input.
- `.ayy-combobox__option` — An <li role="option">. data-value is what it stands for, data-label what goes in the input, data-keywords more words that match. aria-selected="true" on the one the arrow keys are on; aria-disabled for one you can't pick.
- `.ayy-combobox__meta` — Extra text at the end of an option (a country, a count). Not put in the input.
- `.ayy-combobox__empty` — The "No matches" line (role="none"), shown when nothing matches.

**States**
- `hover` (`.ayy-combobox__option:hover`)
- `focus` (`the input's :focus-visible`)
- `disabled` (`.ayy-combobox__option[aria-disabled="true"]; disabled on the input`)
- `selected` (`.ayy-combobox__option[aria-selected="true"]`)
- `error` (`aria-invalid="true" on the input`)
- `open` (`input[aria-expanded="true"], listbox :popover-open`)
- `empty` (`.ayy-combobox__empty shown`)

**Sizes**
- `sm` — The input at Input sm.
- `md` (default) — The input at Input md.
- `lg` — The input at Input lg.
- Density — Input height (md control height, 32px compact, 40 comfortable, 44 touch) and options (sm control height, 28px compact, 32 comfortable, 40 touch) follow data-density.
- Width — Fills its container; the list is at most 28rem wide.

**Custom element** `<ayy-combobox>` (@danitesler/ayywi/elements) — 
- attribute `manual`: Don't filter: replace the options yourself as people type (a search API), then call refresh().
- event `ayy-select`: { value, label, option } when an option is chosen — value is its data-value, else its label.

**React** — `import { Combobox } from "@danitesler/ayywi/react";`
- `<Combobox>` renders <div class="ayy-combobox"><input role="combobox" class="ayy-input"><svg><ul role="listbox" class="ayy-combobox__listbox">. Props: `options` ({ value, label, meta?, icon?, keywords?, disabled? } | string)[]; `value / defaultValue` The chosen option's value.; `onValueChange` (value: string, option: ComboboxOption | null) => void — ("", null) once when the field is cleared; `onInputChange` (text: string) => void — every keystroke, e.g. to fetch options; `filter` boolean, default true; false when you fetch the options yourself; `emptyText` ReactNode, default "No matches"; `size` "sm" | "md" | "lg"; `name` string — a hidden input carries the chosen value in forms

**Accessibility**
- Focus stays in the input: Down opens the list and moves through it, Up goes back, Enter picks, Esc closes (and a second Esc clears), Alt+Down opens without moving. Screen readers follow aria-activedescendant.
- Label the input with a <label for> its id; the chevron is decoration.
- Typing highlights the first match, so Enter picks it; options that don't match are hidden, and "No matches" shows when none do.

**Do**
- Use a combobox to pick one of many known values: more than ten or so, where people know what they're looking for (a city, a customer, a time zone).
- Give options keywords for the other words people type (the country for a city, the email for a customer), and meta for what helps tell them apart.
- For results from a server, set filter={false} (or manual on <ayy-combobox>) and replace the options on each keystroke.

**Examples**: Time zone. Copy-ready HTML and React in llms/combobox.md.

## Tag input

Category: Forms. A field that turns what you type into removable chips, for tags, labels or email recipients. It can also suggest options as you type. Also called: tag-input, tags-input, token-input, chip-input, tag-field, tag-editor.

**Classes**
- `.ayy-tag-input` — Root: looks like an .ayy-input, holds the chips then the input, and grows to more lines as needed. Clicking its empty space focuses the input. With suggestions add ayy-combobox and put an .ayy-combobox__listbox inside.
- `.ayy-tag-input__tag` — A tag, on an .ayy-chip.ayy-chip--removable <span data-value> with its .ayy-chip__remove button (aria-label "Remove design").
- `.ayy-tag-input__input` — The borderless <input type="text"> after the chips; the field's id, label and aria-describedby go on it.
- `.ayy-tag-input--sm` — Small, like ayy-input--sm.
- `.ayy-tag-input--lg` — Large, like ayy-input--lg (a phone form).

**States**
- `hover` (`:hover (devices that hover)`)
- `focus` (`.ayy-tag-input:has(> .ayy-tag-input__input:focus-visible)`)
- `disabled` (`.ayy-tag-input:has(> .ayy-tag-input__input:disabled)`)
- `selected` (`a suggestion's aria-selected (Combobox option)`)
- `error` (`aria-invalid="true" on .ayy-tag-input__input`)
- `open` (`input[aria-expanded="true"]`)

**Sizes**
- `sm` — At least the sm control height (28px compact, 32 comfortable, 40 touch), sm text.
- `md` (default) — At least the md control height (32px compact, 40 comfortable, 44 touch).
- `lg` — At least the lg control height (40px compact, 48 comfortable, 52 touch), more padding, lg text.
- Density — The first line's height follows data-density (above); each line of tags adds a chip's height.
- Width — Fills its container; tags wrap.

**Custom element** `<ayy-tag-input>` (@danitesler/ayywi/elements) — 
- attribute `name`: Form name: a hidden input per tag carries it.
- attribute `max`: Most tags allowed.
- attribute `case-sensitive`: Keep tags that differ only in case apart.
- event `ayy-change`: { values } — every tag, after one is added or removed.

**React** — `import { TagInput } from "@danitesler/ayywi/react";`
- `<TagInput>` renders <div class="ayy-tag-input"> chips + <input class="ayy-tag-input__input"> (+ a listbox with suggestions); other props go on the input, className on the root. Props: `value / defaultValue` string[] — the tags; `onValueChange` (values: string[]) => void; `suggestions` string[] — known tags listed as you type; added ones show disabled; `emptyText` ReactNode — in the suggestions list when nothing matches. Default "Press Enter to add it"; `max` number — most tags; `caseSensitive` boolean — keep "Design" and "design" apart; `size` "sm" | "md" | "lg"; `name` string — a hidden input per tag; `removeLabel` (value) => string — the × button's name. Default "Remove <tag>"; `className` string — on the root

**Accessibility**
- Label the inner input with <Label htmlFor> on its id and describe how to add a tag in a FieldHint ("Press Enter or type a comma").
- Each chip's × is a real button named "Remove design"; Backspace in the empty field removes the last tag too.
- Adding and removing are announced in a polite live region ("design added"), and focus stays in the input.
- With suggestions the input is a combobox: arrows move through them, Enter adds the highlighted one, and ones already added are aria-disabled.

**Do**
- Use it for a short open list of free text: tags, labels, keywords, email recipients.
- Offer the tags people already use as suggestions so they don't create near-duplicates.
- Set max when there's a limit, and say it in the hint.
- Check each tag (an email address) in onValueChange and show a FieldError for a bad one.

**Examples**: Tags with suggestions, Recipients, large, at most 5. Copy-ready HTML and React in llms/tag-input.md.

## Record picker

Category: Forms. A tag field whose chips are records picked from a list: one person to assign, many labels to apply. Type to filter, Enter picks the active record, Backspace in the empty field removes the last, and a create row turns new text into a record. Also called: record-picker, record-select, record-field, people-picker, assignee-picker, entity-picker, multi-select-picker.

**Classes**
- `.ayy-record-picker` — Root: an ayy-tag-input and ayy-combobox holding the chips, the input, the clear button and the listbox.
- `.ayy-record-picker--multiple` — Several records: chips wrap, and the list stays open after each pick (aria-multiselectable).
- `.ayy-record-picker__tag` — One picked record, an .ayy-chip--removable.ayy-tag-input__tag <span data-value> with a named .ayy-chip__remove button; the label shrinks so the × stays inside.
- `.ayy-record-picker__tag-label` — The record's name inside a chip: it shrinks and ellipsises when the name is longer than the field, instead of pushing the × out.
- `.ayy-record-picker__input` — The borderless <input role="combobox"> after the chips; the field's id, label and aria-describedby go on it.
- `.ayy-record-picker__clear` — The icon button after the input that clears every chip, named by aria-label ("Clear"); hidden while nothing is picked.
- `.ayy-record-picker__listbox` — The .ayy-combobox__listbox: records, the create row and the empty row. At least as wide as the field; at most 24rem unless the field is wider.
- `.ayy-record-picker__option` — One record, an .ayy-combobox__option[role="option"] with data-value, data-label and data-keywords. Active: data-active="true"; picked: aria-selected="true" and a check.
- `.ayy-record-picker__option-body` — The two lines after the icon: name and description. Takes the row's leftover width.
- `.ayy-record-picker__option-label` — The record's name, one line with an ellipsis.
- `.ayy-record-picker__description` — The muted second line (an email, a role, a key), one line with an ellipsis.
- `.ayy-record-picker__create` — The last option: "Create “Maya”" when creatable, the query isn't empty and no record matches exactly.
- `.ayy-record-picker__create-label` — The create row's text, written by the controller from createLabel.
- `.ayy-record-picker__empty` — The muted, centred row when nothing matches ("No people").

**States**
- `hover` (`.ayy-record-picker__clear:hover (hover devices) and a list option under the pointer`)
- `focus` (`.ayy-record-picker__clear:focus-visible and the field's input`)
- `disabled` (`disabled on the input and on the chips' × and clear buttons`)
- `selected` (`aria-selected="true" on an .ayy-record-picker__option`)
- `error` (`aria-invalid="true" on the input`)
- `open` (`input[aria-expanded="true"]`)

**Sizes**
- `sm` — Tag input's sm: at least --ayy-size-control-sm, sm text.
- `md` (default) — Tag input's md: at least --ayy-size-control-md (32px compact, 40px comfortable, 44px touch).
- `lg` — Tag input's lg: at least --ayy-size-control-lg, more padding, lg text.
- Density — The field and chips follow data-density through Tag input; the clear button is as tall as the field's inner height, so the field keeps its size token.
- Width — Fills its container; chips wrap in multiple mode. The listbox is at least the field's width, and no wider than 24rem unless the field is wider.

**Custom element** `<ayy-record-picker>` (@danitesler/ayywi/elements) — An .ayy-record-picker with the picked records' chips, its input, the clear button and the .ayy-record-picker__listbox of .ayy-record-picker__option rows.
- attribute `multiple`: Pick several records; the list stays open after each pick.
- attribute `creatable`: Offer a create row for the typed text when no record matches.
- attribute `manual`: Don't filter: replace the options yourself (a search API), then call refresh().
- attribute `name`: Form name: a hidden input per picked id carries it.
- event `ayy-change`: { ids, options: [{ id, label }] } — after every pick, removal and clear.
- event `ayy-create`: { id, label } — when the create row is picked; the chip already exists. Replace the slug id with the saved record's id.

**React** — `import { RecordPicker } from "@danitesler/ayywi/react";`
- `<RecordPicker>` renders <div class="ayy-record-picker ayy-tag-input ayy-combobox"> chips + <input role="combobox"> + clear button + <ul class="ayy-combobox__listbox">; other props go on the input, className on the root. Props: `options` RecordPickerOption[] — id, label, description?, icon?, keywords?, disabled?; `value / defaultValue` string[] — the picked ids; value makes it controlled; `onValueChange` (ids: string[], options: RecordPickerOption[]) => void; `multiple` boolean — several records; the list stays open; `creatable` boolean — offer a create row; `onCreate` (label) => RecordPickerOption | void — return the new option to select it, or update options and value yourself; `createLabel` (label) => string — the create row's text. Default "Create “<label>”"; `emptyText` ReactNode — when nothing matches. Default "No matches"; `size` "sm" | "md" | "lg"; `name` string — a hidden input per picked id; `clearable` boolean — show the clear button. Default true; `clearLabel` string — its name. Default "Clear"; `removeLabel` (option) => string — a chip's × name. Default "Remove <label>"; `className` string — on the root

**Accessibility**
- Label the input with <Label htmlFor> and aria-labelledby (or aria-label); the controller copies that name onto the listbox, so the list reads as "Assignee".
- The input keeps focus: arrows move aria-activedescendant, Enter picks, Escape closes and clears the query, and the pointer never moves focus into the list.
- In multiple mode the list is aria-multiselectable: picked records carry aria-selected and a check, and picking one again removes it.
- Each chip's × is named "Remove Ada Lovelace", and Backspace in the empty field removes the last chip.

**Do**
- Use it to attach records to something: an assignee, labels, projects, reviewers.
- Give options a description when names repeat, and keywords for what people type (an email, a project key).
- Turn on creatable only when a new record is allowed, and save it in onCreate so its id is the real one.

**Examples**: Assignee, one person, Labels, several and creatable. Copy-ready HTML and React in llms/record-picker.md.

## Transfer list

Category: Forms. A dual-list shuttle for moving items between an available column and a selected column, such as role permissions, export columns or team members. Each column supports live filtering, select-all and keyboard navigation. Also called: transfer-list, dual-list, dual-listbox, list-shuttle, shuttle.

**Classes**
- `.ayy-transfer-list` — Root 3-column grid (source pane, transfer actions, target pane); stacks vertically below 48rem.
- `.ayy-transfer-list__pane` — One list column card (data-pane="source" or data-pane="target").
- `.ayy-transfer-list__header` — Pane top row holding the select-all checkbox, title and item count.
- `.ayy-transfer-list__title` — Clickable label wrapping the pane's select-all Checkbox and heading.
- `.ayy-transfer-list__count` — Tabular item count at the inline end ("2 / 6" when items are checked).
- `.ayy-transfer-list__search` — Optional filter row under the header with a magnifier icon and borderless input.
- `.ayy-transfer-list__filter` — Per-pane <input type="search"> filter.
- `.ayy-transfer-list__list` — Scrollable list body (14rem tall) of checkable item rows.
- `.ayy-transfer-list__item` — One <label> row holding an .ayy-checkbox and the item's text.
- `.ayy-transfer-list__item-body` — Text column inside an item row.
- `.ayy-transfer-list__label` — Primary item name.
- `.ayy-transfer-list__description` — Optional muted second line under the item name.
- `.ayy-transfer-list__empty` — Centred muted empty or no-matches message inside a pane.
- `.ayy-transfer-list__actions` — Middle column (row on phones) of transfer icon buttons.

**States**
- `hover` (`.ayy-transfer-list__item:hover (hover devices)`)
- `focus` (`:focus-visible on a Checkbox, transfer Button or .ayy-transfer-list__filter`)
- `disabled` (`disabled on item Checkboxes, the filter input or transfer Buttons`)
- `selected` (`:checked on an item's Checkbox (pending transfer), or presence in the target pane (assigned)`)
- `error` (`aria-invalid="true" on .ayy-transfer-list (with a FieldError)`)

**Sizes**
- Density — Header height, search bar height, checkboxes and transfer buttons follow data-density; list viewport stays 14rem tall.
- Width — Fills its container across two equal columns; stacks into a single column with rotated arrows below 48rem.

**Custom element** `<ayy-transfer-list>` (@danitesler/ayywi/elements) — An .ayy-transfer-list containing source and target .ayy-transfer-list__pane elements and .ayy-transfer-list__actions.
- attribute `name`: Form field name: syncs one hidden input per item in the target pane.
- event `ayy-change`: { value: string[] } — fired whenever items move between panes.

**React** — `import { TransferList } from "@danitesler/ayywi/react";`
- `<TransferList>` renders <div role="group" class="ayy-transfer-list"> with source pane, action buttons and target pane. Props: `options` TransferListOption[] — id, label, description?, keywords?, disabled?; `value / defaultValue` string[] — IDs in the target (selected) pane.; `onValueChange` (value: string[]) => void; `sourceTitle` string — heading of the available pane (default "Available").; `targetTitle` string — heading of the selected pane (default "Selected").; `searchable` boolean — show a filter input in each pane (default false).; `searchPlaceholder` string — placeholder for filter inputs (default "Filter…").; `showMoveAll` boolean — include Move all / Remove all buttons (default true).; `sourceEmptyText` string — empty message for source pane.; `targetEmptyText` string — empty message for target pane.; `disabled` boolean; `invalid` boolean — sets aria-invalid="true".; `name` string — renders hidden inputs for selected IDs.; `...rest` All native <div> attributes.

**Accessibility**
- Every item is a real Checkbox inside a <label>, so screen readers announce its label, description and checked state natively.
- ArrowUp, ArrowDown, Home and End move focus between visible checkboxes in a pane; Space toggles.
- Transfer icon buttons carry descriptive aria-labels ("Move selected to Assigned") and Tooltips, and disable when no items can move.

**Do**
- Use a Transfer list when users need to see both what is available and what is assigned side by side (role permissions, report columns).
- Turn on searchable when either column can hold more than ~10 items.

**Examples**: Role permissions with search. Copy-ready HTML and React in llms/transfer-list.md.

## Date & time picker

Category: Forms. Pickers for a date, a date range, a time, or a date with a time. They work inline or in a popover, and can be used fully from the keyboard. Also called: date-time-picker, datetimepicker, date-picker, datepicker, date-range, daterange, time-picker, timepicker, calendar, month-grid.

**Classes**
- `.ayy-date-picker` — The single date picker trigger button, styled like a field with a calendar icon and the date. Opens a popover with the DatePickerGrid.
- `.ayy-date-picker__value` — The date text inside the trigger. Empty shows its data-placeholder, muted.
- `.ayy-date-picker-grid` — Root of the single month grid: a column of header, weekdays, and 42 day buttons. Day size follows data-density.
- `.ayy-date-picker-grid--full` — Fills its container's width (a phone screen, a bottom sheet); days grow up to 1.5× their size.
- `.ayy-date-picker-grid__header` — The month/year period buttons, then the two arrow buttons at the inline end.
- `.ayy-date-picker-grid__title` — Month and year heading container (e.g. "October 2026"), with aria-live="polite".
- `.ayy-date-picker-grid__period` — Month or year button inside the header that swaps the day grid for the month or year picker.
- `.ayy-date-picker-grid__nav` — Previous / next month, year, or year-range button with an aria-label and a directional arrow icon.
- `.ayy-date-picker-grid__weekdays` — Short weekday names over the columns, aria-hidden.
- `.ayy-date-picker-grid__grid` — The 42 day buttons, role="group" labelled by the month. One Tab stop: the picked day, else today, else the 1st has tabindex="0".
- `.ayy-date-picker-grid__day` — Day button with data-date="2026-10-07" and aria-label. aria-pressed="true" picked, aria-current="date" today, aria-disabled="true" outside min/max, data-outside for neighbouring months.
- `.ayy-date-picker-grid__months` — The 3×4 grid of 12 month buttons shown when the month header button is clicked.
- `.ayy-date-picker-grid__years` — The 3×4 grid of 12 year buttons shown when the year header button is clicked.
- `.ayy-date-picker-grid__cell` — Individual month or year button inside the 3×4 month or year picker grid.
- `.ayy-date-picker-grid__presets` — Row of quick dates above the month, in equal columns. role="group" with an aria-label ("Quick dates").
- `.ayy-date-picker-grid__preset` — A quick date button with an icon over a short label. aria-pressed="true" when it's the picked day.
- `.ayy-date-picker-grid__footer` — Under the month, after a hairline: action buttons like Clear, Today, or Done.
- `.ayy-date-range` — Root container: displays month grids side by side (or stacked on narrow viewports). Day size follows data-density.
- `.ayy-date-range__month` — One month container with a header, weekday labels, and a 42-day (or 3×4 month/year) grid.
- `.ayy-date-range__header` — The month/year period buttons and navigation arrow buttons.
- `.ayy-date-range__title` — Month and year heading container (e.g. "October 2026"), with aria-live="polite".
- `.ayy-date-range__period` — Month or year button inside the range header that swaps that column into a month or year picker.
- `.ayy-date-range__nav` — Previous / next month, year, or year-range button with directional arrow icon, aria-label, and focus ring.
- `.ayy-date-range__weekdays` — Row of short weekday names above the month grid, aria-hidden.
- `.ayy-date-range__grid` — The 42-day button grid, role="group" labelled by the month title.
- `.ayy-date-range__day` — Day button with data-date="2026-10-12" and full aria-label.
- `.ayy-date-range__months` — The 3×4 grid of 12 month buttons shown in a range column when its month button is clicked.
- `.ayy-date-range__years` — The 3×4 grid of 12 year buttons shown in a range column when its year button is clicked.
- `.ayy-date-range__cell` — Individual month or year button inside a date range column's month or year picker.
- `.ayy-date-range__day--range-start` — The start of the picked range: primary filled, rounded inline-start.
- `.ayy-date-range__day--range-end` — The end of the picked range: primary filled, rounded inline-end.
- `.ayy-date-range__day--in-range` — Days between start and end: wash-hover background forming a continuous connected band.
- `.ayy-date-range-picker` — Trigger button styled like an input field, opening a popover with the DateRange.
- `.ayy-date-range-picker__value` — Text displaying the formatted date range (e.g. "Oct 12, 2026 – Oct 18, 2026"). Empty shows its data-placeholder.
- `.ayy-date-range__footer` — Footer under the range months: action buttons like Clear and Today.
- `.ayy-time-picker` — Root container of the time picker: displays scrollable columns of hours, minutes, and optional period.
- `.ayy-time-picker__header` — Header container above the time picker columns holding manual time inputs.
- `.ayy-time-picker__inputs` — Flex row holding hour, minute, and optional period manual input controls.
- `.ayy-time-picker__input` — Two-digit numeric input for typing hours or minutes directly, syncing bidirectionally with the scrollable column.
- `.ayy-time-picker__separator` — Colon separator between hour and minute manual inputs.
- `.ayy-time-picker__period-btn` — Toggle button for switching AM/PM in 12-hour format manual input header.
- `.ayy-time-picker__columns` — Horizontal flex row holding the scrollable columns.
- `.ayy-time-picker__col` — Scrollable column of hour or minute buttons with top and bottom fade masks.
- `.ayy-time-picker__item` — Individual hour, minute, or period button. Keyboard-navigable with arrow keys.
- `.ayy-time-picker__item--selected` — The currently selected time item: primary filled with semibold text.
- `.ayy-time-picker-trigger` — Trigger button styled like an input field, opening a popover with the TimePicker.
- `.ayy-time-picker-trigger__value` — Text displaying the formatted time string (e.g. "14:30" or "02:30 PM"). Empty shows its data-placeholder.
- `.ayy-date-time-picker` — Compound container displaying DatePickerGrid and TimePicker side by side separated by a hairline divider.
- `.ayy-date-time-picker__date` — Container for the date picker grid section.
- `.ayy-date-time-picker__divider` — Vertical hairline divider between date and time sections.
- `.ayy-date-time-picker__time` — Container for the time picker columns section.
- `.ayy-date-time-picker__footer` — Footer below the combined date and time sections: action buttons like Clear and Today.
- `.ayy-date-time-picker-trigger` — Trigger button styled like an input field, opening a popover with the DateTimePicker.
- `.ayy-date-time-picker-trigger__value` — Text displaying formatted combined date and time string. Empty shows data-placeholder.

**States**
- `hover` (`:hover on day buttons, month/year cells, period buttons, nav arrows, presets, time items`)
- `pressed` (`:active on day buttons, month/year cells, and time items`)
- `focus` (`:focus-visible on an interactive day, month/year cell, period button, arrow, or time item`)
- `disabled` (`[aria-disabled="true"] or :disabled`)
- `selected` (`[aria-pressed="true"], [aria-selected="true"], range-start, range-end`)
- `error` (`[aria-invalid="true"] on a trigger button`)
- `today` (`[aria-current="date"]`)
- `outside` (`[data-outside]`)
- `empty` (`__value:empty`)

**Sizes**
- `sm` — Trigger buttons at Input sm.
- `md` (default) — Trigger buttons at Input md.
- `lg` — Trigger buttons at Input lg.
- Density — Day cells are the md control height (32px compact, 40 comfortable, 44 touch); time items follow md control height; nav buttons are sm control height.
- Width — Single date fits 7 days; side-by-side range fits two month grids (approx 36rem); combined date-time fits month plus time columns (approx 30rem).

**Custom element** `<ayy-date-picker>` (@danitesler/ayywi/elements) — 
- attribute `value`: The picked value (ISO date, time, or ISO date-time string).
- attribute `min`: Earliest pickable ISO date.
- attribute `max`: Latest pickable ISO date.
- event `ayy-select`: { value } when a selection is made.

**Custom element** `<ayy-date-range>` (@danitesler/ayywi/elements) — 
- attribute `start`: Range start ISO date.
- attribute `end`: Range end ISO date.
- attribute `min`: Earliest pickable ISO date.
- attribute `max`: Latest pickable ISO date.
- attribute `months`: Number of months to show side-by-side (default 2).
- event `ayy-select`: { value } when a range is picked.

**Custom element** `<ayy-time-picker>` (@danitesler/ayywi/elements) — 
- attribute `value`: The picked time string.
- attribute `format`: "12h" | "24h" — time format.
- attribute `step`: Minute step between items.
- event `ayy-select`: { value } when a time is picked.

**Custom element** `<ayy-date-time-picker>` (@danitesler/ayywi/elements) — 
- attribute `value`: The picked ISO date-time string.
- attribute `min`: Earliest pickable ISO date.
- attribute `max`: Latest pickable ISO date.
- attribute `format`: "12h" | "24h" — time format.
- attribute `step`: Minute step between items.
- attribute `week-start`: Weekday index (0=Sun, 1=Mon, 6=Sat) to start weeks on.
- event `ayy-select`: { value } when date or time changes.

**React** — `import { DatePicker, DatePickerGrid, DateRangePicker, DateRange, TimePicker, TimePickerTrigger, DateTimePicker, DateTimePickerTrigger } from "@danitesler/ayywi/react";`
- `<DatePickerGrid>` renders <div class="ayy-date-picker-grid">…<div class="ayy-date-picker-grid__grid" role="group">. Props: `value` string | null — the picked ISO day; `defaultValue` string | null — initial picked day; `onValueChange` (date: string) => void; `min` string — earliest pickable day; `max` string — latest pickable day; `today` string — override today; `weekStart` Weekday — first day of the week (0 = Sunday); `locale` string — locale for month and day names; `full` boolean — fill container width; `previousLabel` string — accessible name of previous month arrow; `nextLabel` string — accessible name of next month arrow; `presets` DatePickerPreset[] — shortcuts above the month; `presetsLabel` string — accessible name of the presets group; `showActions` boolean — whether to show Clear and Today action buttons in a footer; `clearLabel` string — label for Clear button; `todayLabel` string — label for Today button; `onClear` () => void — callback when Clear is clicked; `onToday` () => void — callback when Today is clicked; `footer` ReactNode — content under the month
- `<DatePicker>` renders <button class="ayy-input ayy-date-picker" aria-haspopup="dialog"> + <div class="ayy-popover" popover> with DatePickerGrid. Props: `value` string | null — the ISO day; `defaultValue` string | null — initial ISO day; `onValueChange` (date: string) => void — popover closes after it; `placeholder` string — shown while empty. Default "Pick a date"; `format` (date: string) => string — trigger's text formatter; `min` string — earliest pickable day; `max` string — latest pickable day; `today` string — override today; `weekStart` Weekday — first day of the week; `locale` string — locale for month and day names; `size` "sm" | "md" | "lg" — trigger button size; `name` string — a hidden input carries the ISO day; `presets` DatePickerPreset[] — shortcuts above the month; `showActions` boolean — whether to show Clear and Today action buttons in the popover footer. Default true; `clearLabel` string — label for Clear button; `todayLabel` string — label for Today button; `onClear` () => void — callback when Clear is clicked; `onToday` () => void — callback when Today is clicked; `footer` ReactNode — content under the month
- `<DateRange>` renders <div class="ayy-date-range"> with side-by-side month grids. Props: `value` [string, string] | null — start and end ISO dates; `defaultValue` [string, string] | null — initial range; `onValueChange` (range: [string, string] | null) => void — null when Clear empties it; `months` number — number of months shown side-by-side; `min` string — earliest pickable day; `max` string — latest pickable day; `today` string — override today; `weekStart` Weekday — first day of the week; `locale` string — locale for month and day names; `previousLabel` string — accessible name of previous month arrow; `nextLabel` string — accessible name of next month arrow; `showActions` boolean — whether to show Clear and Today action buttons in a footer; `clearLabel` string — label for Clear button; `todayLabel` string — label for Today button; `onClear` () => void — callback when Clear is clicked; `onToday` () => void — callback when Today is clicked; `footer` ReactNode — content under the range months
- `<DateRangePicker>` renders <button class="ayy-input ayy-date-range-picker" aria-haspopup="dialog"> + <div class="ayy-popover" popover> with DateRange. Props: `value` [string, string] | null — start and end ISO dates; `defaultValue` [string, string] | null — initial range; `onValueChange` (range: [string, string] | null) => void — null when Clear empties it; `placeholder` string — shown while empty; `format` (range: [string, string]) => string — trigger text formatter; `months` number — number of months shown side-by-side; `min` string — earliest pickable day; `max` string — latest pickable day; `today` string — override today; `weekStart` Weekday — first day of the week; `locale` string — locale for month and day names; `size` "sm" | "md" | "lg" — trigger button size; `name` string — hidden inputs carry start and end dates; `showActions` boolean — whether to show Clear and Today action buttons in the popover footer. Default true; `clearLabel` string — label for Clear button; `todayLabel` string — label for Today button; `onClear` () => void — callback when Clear is clicked; `onToday` () => void — callback when Today is clicked; `footer` ReactNode — content under the range months
- `<TimePicker>` renders <div class="ayy-time-picker"> with scrollable columns of hours and minutes. Props: `value` string — time string ("14:30" or "02:30 PM"); `defaultValue` string — initial time string; `onValueChange` (time: string) => void; `format` "12h" | "24h" — clock format; `step` number — minute step between options; `manualInput` boolean — whether to show manual numeric inputs at the top
- `<TimePickerTrigger>` renders <button class="ayy-input ayy-time-picker-trigger" aria-haspopup="dialog"> + <div class="ayy-popover" popover> with TimePicker. Props: `value` string — time string; `defaultValue` string — initial time string; `onValueChange` (time: string) => void; `placeholder` string — shown while empty; `format` "12h" | "24h" — clock format; `step` number — minute step between options; `size` "sm" | "md" | "lg" — trigger button size; `name` string — hidden input carries time string
- `<DateTimePicker>` renders <div class="ayy-date-time-picker"> with DatePickerGrid and TimePicker side-by-side. Props: `value` string — ISO date-time ("2026-10-14T14:30"); `defaultValue` string — initial date-time string; `onValueChange` (dateTime: string) => void; `format` "12h" | "24h" — time format; `step` number — minute step; `min` string — earliest pickable date; `max` string — latest pickable date; `today` string — override today; `weekStart` Weekday — first day of the week; `locale` string — locale for formatting; `showActions` boolean — whether to show Clear and Today action buttons in a footer; `clearLabel` string — label for Clear button; `todayLabel` string — label for Today button; `onClear` () => void — callback when Clear is clicked; `onToday` () => void — callback when Today is clicked; `footer` ReactNode — content under the compound picker
- `<DateTimePickerTrigger>` renders <button class="ayy-input ayy-date-time-picker-trigger" aria-haspopup="dialog"> + <div class="ayy-popover" popover> with DateTimePicker. Props: `value` string — ISO date-time string; `defaultValue` string — initial date-time string; `onValueChange` (dateTime: string) => void; `placeholder` string — shown while empty; `format` "12h" | "24h" — time format; `step` number — minute step; `min` string — earliest pickable date; `max` string — latest pickable date; `today` string — override today; `weekStart` Weekday — first day of the week; `locale` string — locale for formatting; `size` "sm" | "md" | "lg" — trigger button size; `name` string — hidden input carries date-time string; `showActions` boolean — whether to show Clear and Today action buttons in the popover footer. Default true; `clearLabel` string — label for Clear button; `todayLabel` string — label for Today button; `onClear` () => void — callback when Clear is clicked; `onToday` () => void — callback when Today is clicked; `footer` ReactNode — content under the compound picker

**Accessibility**
- Grids and time columns are single Tab stops. Arrow keys move selection within grids or columns.
- State is reflected in aria-pressed, aria-selected, aria-current="date", and aria-disabled.
- Month headers use aria-live="polite" so page changes are announced to screen readers.
- Buttons have full accessible labels (e.g. "Wednesday, 7 October 2026").
- High contrast mode (forced-colors: active) renders solid system borders and highlight backgrounds.

**Do**
- Use DatePicker or DatePickerGrid for picking a single date near today.
- Use DateRange or DateRangePicker for date spans (stays, bookings, analytics intervals).
- Use TimePicker or TimePickerTrigger for picking discrete hours and minutes.
- Use DateTimePicker or DateTimePickerTrigger when both date and time must be chosen together.

**Examples**: Date picker, Date range picker, Time picker, Date & time picker, Month grid with presets. Copy-ready HTML and React in llms/date-time-picker.md.

## Color picker

Category: Forms. A panel for choosing any colour. It combines an area for shade and brightness, sliders for hue and transparency, a hex field and a row of preset colours. Also called: color-selector, colour-selector, palette-picker, color-chooser, hsv-picker.

**Classes**
- `.ayy-color-picker` — Panel container: flex column holding the 2D area, sliders, text input, and optional preset swatches.
- `.ayy-color-picker__area` — 2D saturation and brightness gradient area with a crosshair handle; drag or use arrow keys to adjust saturation and value.
- `.ayy-color-picker__handle` — Draggable crosshair pointer on the 2D area positioned by --_x and --_y.
- `.ayy-color-picker__sliders` — Row containing the preview swatch and range sliders.
- `.ayy-color-picker__hue` — Rainbow track range slider (0–360) controlling the hue.
- `.ayy-color-picker__alpha` — Checkerboard and gradient track range slider (0–100) controlling opacity.
- `.ayy-color-picker__preview` — Color swatch showing the currently picked colour over a transparency checkerboard.
- `.ayy-color-picker__inputs` — Row holding the hex colour text input.
- `.ayy-color-picker__copy` — Copy button inside the hex inputs row or input group.
- `.ayy-color-picker__swatches` — Row of preset colour swatch buttons.
- `.ayy-color-picker__swatch` — One preset colour button inside the swatches row, coloured by --_swatch.

**States**
- `hover` (`:hover on swatches or slider thumbs`)
- `focus` (`:focus-visible on the 2D area handle, range slider thumbs, text input, or preset swatch buttons`)
- `disabled` (`:disabled or [aria-disabled="true"]`)
- `selected` (`.ayy-color-picker__swatch[aria-pressed="true"]`)

**Sizes**
- Density — Control heights and padding follow data-density: slider tracks and hex input scale from compact to comfortable and touch.
- Width — Panel inline-size (13.5rem / 216px), adapts up to 100% of its container.

**Custom element** `<ayy-color-picker>` (@danitesler/ayywi/elements) — 
- attribute `value`: Hex colour code ("#2563eb"). Updated when the colour changes.
- attribute `alpha`: Allow opacity changes when present (unless "false").
- attribute `name`: Form name: a hidden input inside carries the hex colour.
- event `ayy-change`: { value } when the colour changes.

**React** — `import { ColorPicker } from "@danitesler/ayywi/react";`
- `<ColorPicker>` renders <div class="ayy-color-picker">. Props: `value / defaultValue` string — hex colour code (e.g. "#2563eb"); `onValueChange` (color: string) => void — called when the colour changes; `alpha` boolean — whether to show the alpha slider and allow opacity changes; `swatches` string[] — list of preset colour hex codes; `addon` ReactNode — optional text or element beside the hex input (e.g. "HEX"); `addonPosition` "start" | "end" — placement of the addon beside the input (default "end"); `copyable` boolean — whether to show a copy button inside the hex input group; `...` HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> props

**Accessibility**
- The 2D saturation/brightness area is a focusable role="slider" with aria-label, aria-valuetext, and arrow key navigation (Shift for 10% steps).
- Hue and alpha sliders are native range inputs with accessible labels, keyboard stepped navigation, and Home/End support.
- The hex input allows typing exact hex color codes with keyboard and screen reader support.
- In Windows High Contrast mode, the panel, sliders, swatches, and handle keep clear outlines using CanvasText and Highlight system colors.

**Do**
- Use ColorPicker when people need to pick any custom colour or fine-tune hues, saturation, and transparency (e.g. in graphic design tools, theme customizers, or canvas drawing apps).
- Provide preset swatches for common or brand-approved choices so users don't have to start from scratch.
- Enable alpha only when transparency is supported by the underlying target.

**Examples**: Color picker with alpha and presets, Compact color picker without alpha. Copy-ready HTML and React in llms/color-picker.md.

## Icon picker

Category: Forms. A searchable grid of icons and emoji with a remove button, for marking a column, project, page or label with a symbol. It sits in a Popover or as the submenu panel of a Menu. Also called: emoji-picker, icon-selector, icon-chooser, emoji-selector.

**Classes**
- `.ayy-icon-picker` — Root: a flex column, 17rem wide at most, holding the header, the scrolling body and the empty message.
- `.ayy-icon-picker__header` — Row with the search field and the remove button.
- `.ayy-icon-picker__search` — The <input type="search" class="ayy-input ayy-input--sm"> that filters options by aria-label, data-keywords and data-value. ArrowDown moves into the grid, Enter picks the first match.
- `.ayy-icon-picker__remove` — A ghost sm Button that clears the icon (picks "").
- `.ayy-icon-picker__body` — The scrolling area (15rem tall at most) holding the sections.
- `.ayy-icon-picker__section` — One <div role="group" aria-labelledby> per kind (icons, emoji). Hidden while a search leaves it no options.
- `.ayy-icon-picker__label` — The section's muted heading ("Icons", "Emoji").
- `.ayy-icon-picker__grid` — The grid of options: as many sm-control-sized columns as fit.
- `.ayy-icon-picker__option` — One <button type="button" aria-label aria-pressed data-value> holding an Icon SVG or an emoji character. data-keywords adds search words.
- `.ayy-icon-picker__empty` — The <p role="status" hidden> shown when a search matches nothing.

**States**
- `hover` (`.ayy-icon-picker__option:hover on a device that hovers`)
- `pressed` (`.ayy-icon-picker__option:active`)
- `focus` (`.ayy-icon-picker__option:focus-visible; the search field and remove button use Input's and Button's`)
- `disabled` (`:disabled on an option`)
- `selected` (`aria-pressed="true" on the picked option`)

**Sizes**
- Density — Options are the sm control height (28px compact, 32px comfortable, 40px touch) and the search field is an sm Input, so data-density grows the targets.
- Width — 17rem at most (shrinks with its container); the grid fits as many columns as the width allows and the body scrolls past 15rem.

**Custom element** `<ayy-icon-picker>` (@danitesler/ayywi/elements) — 
- attribute `value`: The picked option's data-value ("" for none). Updated on pick.
- attribute `name`: Form name: a hidden input inside carries the value.
- event `ayy-change`: { value, kind } — kind is "icon", "emoji", or null when removed.

**React** — `import { IconPicker } from "@danitesler/ayywi/react";`
- `<IconPicker>` renders <div class="ayy-icon-picker"> with a search Input, a remove Button and a section per kind. Props: `value / defaultValue` string — the picked icon value or emoji; "" for none; `onValueChange` (value: string, change: { value, kind, option }) => void; `icons` { value: string; label: string; icon: IconData | ReactNode; keywords?: string[] }[] — the Icons section; omit for emoji only; `emojis` { value: string; label: string; keywords?: string[] }[] — the Emoji section (iconPickerEmojis by default; [] hides it); `searchable` boolean — show the search field (default true); `removable` boolean — show the remove button (default true); `iconsLabel / emojisLabel / searchLabel / removeLabel / emptyLabel` string — the visible and accessible text; `...` HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> props

**Accessibility**
